en.name: The Holy Blood of Bruges
en.summary: A crystal vial said to hold blood of Christ has been venerated in Bruges since the Middle Ages.
en.body: The Basilica of the Holy Blood in Bruges venerates a rock-crystal phial said to contain blood of Christ, documented in the city since at least the 1250s, with reports of periodic liquefaction recorded from the early fourteenth century onward.
